title: _get_credentials: `if resolved_http_path is None` branch is provably unreachable
description: After `resolved_http_path = http_path or os.getenv("DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH", "")` the value can never be None: `os.getenv` is called with a non-None default `""`, so the right-hand operand of `or` is always `str`, and `http_path or <str>` therefore always yields a `str`. Moreover, the `missing` aggregation a few lines above already raised `DatabricksConfigError` when `resolved_http_path` was falsy (empty string), so at line 138 it is guaranteed to be a non-empty `str`. The subsequent `if resolved_http_path is None: raise RuntimeError(...)` can never fire and the RuntimeError is dead. mypy already narrows the type to `str` here, so the guard adds no type-safety value either.
evidence: Line 114: `resolved_http_path = http_path or os.getenv("DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH", "")` — type is `str` (both `or` operands are `str`; getenv default is `""`). Lines 121-129: if `not resolved_http_path` (i.e. empty), `missing` is non-empty and `DatabricksConfigError` is raised, returning early. Therefore at line 138 `resolved_http_path` is a non-empty `str`; `resolved_http_path is None` is always False and the `raise RuntimeError(...)` on line 139 is unreachable.
est_reduction: 2 lines (remove the dead `if ... is None: raise RuntimeError(...)` guard).
behavior_preservation: Pure removal of an unreachable branch; the function's return value and all reachable behavior are identical. No caller can observe the difference because the branch never executes.
